how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-shadowfang-keep-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1013:obj:0: Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1013:details:0: ⟦1⟧, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection. Ur was a great mage of ⟦E2⟧ before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1013:details:1: BEnter Shadowfang Keep and find the book. Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
rows.quest:1013:completion:0: Very good. This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur. His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power. And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.
rows.quest:1013:completion:1: BWe of the ⟦E3⟧ cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...
rows.quest:1014:obj:0: Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:1014:details:0: Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.
rows.quest:1014:details:1: BI shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, ⟦2⟧. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.
rows.quest:1014:details:2: BTravel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
rows.quest:1014:completion:0: ⟦E4⟧ is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, ⟦3⟧. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:1098:obj:0: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
rows.quest:1098:details:0: In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence. It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!
rows.quest:1098:details:1: BSo here is your task, ⟦4⟧. Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent. Find them, and if they require aid then give it.
rows.quest:1098:details:2: BThis mission is as dangerous as is it critical, ⟦5⟧. Do not fail.
rows.quest:1098:completion:0: Vincent's body lies broken, and still.
rows.quest:1098:completion:1: BAlthough Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.
rows.quest:1098:completion:2: BBut clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
